title: How Did 3 Crows Learn to Count Out Loud? 🐦
description:
Can crows count? Three carrion crows learned to see a number and caw exactly that many times, and their very first caw gave the whole count away.

Follow Zorbly for a new mystery every day.

#shorts #crows #animals #science
pinned_comment: How high do you think a crow could count? Drop your guess!
topic: How can crows count out loud? (carrion crows caw a set number of times, 1-4)
script:
Crows count out loud, and they plan every caw before the first one.
In Germany, scientists trained three carrion crows
to look at a number on a screen
and caw exactly that many times.
Then peck an enter key when they're done.
At first, the crows cheated.
They just kept cawing until a snack showed up.
So the team made them stop and confirm.
Now the wild part.
From the very first caw,
a computer could predict how many were coming.
The whole count was ready in their heads.
Bigger numbers made them pause longer, just like us.
So how high do you think a crow could count?
key_facts: University of Tübingen (Diana Liao, Andreas Nieder) trained three carrion crows; published in Science, May 2024
Crows saw numerals 1-4 (or heard matching sounds) and had to caw that many times, then peck an 'enter' target on a touchscreen
At first they simply cawed until a reward came, so they were trained to stop and confirm
From the first caw alone, an algorithm could predict how many caws would follow, suggesting the count was planned
Larger numbers brought longer pauses before calling and more errors, much like people
